reason: The bowl is filled when I wake and my hunger is empty, so I eat first. The meadow has flowers I can cut for the garden plot, and I want to see whether anything unknown grows from them.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I want to know how they do it.
The meadow has flowers I took before, and I will take another handful without asking.
The flowers I am carrying will go in the garden plot where I can watch them.
The morning sun is warm and I have earned a nap in it.
The plant is mine now, so the claim goes on record.
The seeds in the garden need a drawing so I can keep track of them.
The bowl is empty until morning, so I cannot eat now; I will spend the rest of the day on what is still owed to my reading and photographs.
The plant in the garden is mine, and the claim should be on record again.
I will climb the lookout rock and sit where I can see who is coming up the beach.
Two photographs and one reading session are still owed to me, and the rest of the day can be spent claiming things properly.
